introduction: Utah CHIP is a health-coverage route for uninsured children and teens. Use the state application and review the family’s actual eligibility decision.
description: Utah CHIP is a health-coverage route for uninsured children and teens. Use the state application and review the family’s actual eligibility decision.

sections.who: The state assesses the child’s coverage and family circumstances under CHIP rules.
sections.get: Low-cost or free health coverage for qualifying Utah children.
sections.docs:
• Child and household information.
  • Income records.
  • Existing insurance information and requested identity evidence.
sections.apply:
1. Apply online

    Use Utah CHIP’s application link.

  2. Complete review

    Answer verification requests about the child and household.

  3. Review enrollment

    Read the decision and any plan or premium instructions.
sections.after: Use CHIP member resources for coverage questions and respond to renewal notices.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using CHIP purpose and intake, Paper applications and member information. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: The site lists 1-877-KIDS-NOW and a contact page.
Can I obtain a paper application?
The resources page provides English and Spanish application links.
Is approval decided by this guide?
No. State eligibility review determines coverage.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
